messages:
alex: heads up — CI red on branch feature/cache-ttl (pipeline #4823). Failing only on linux-worker, mac and windows passed earlier.

ci-bot: Build failed: ubuntu-22 • tests/test_integration_cache.py::test_cache_invalidation (exit code 1)

alex: stack trace looks like an assertion in test: `expected key to be evicted` — but the code change touching cache TTL was merged in the feature branch.

maya: did you try a rerun? sometimes flakey with the infra image.

alex: just kicked a rerun (manual). If it flakes again I'll need help bisecting.

ci-bot: Rerun started by @alex — job 4823.2

ryan: if it repros consistently on ubuntu-22 we should see logs. alex can you paste failing snippet?

alex: here is the failing part: ```
E   AssertionError: Cache still contains key after TTL expired
E   Expected: False
E   Actual: True

/runner/work/redwood/redwood/tests/test_integration_cache.py:78
```

maya: hmm that looks like timing sensitivity. The branch bumped default ttl in Cache.build() to 5s from 3s? that should make evictions *slower* to happen, not faster.

taylor: quick thought — did the branch also change the test's time.sleep? I remember a recent tweak in test harness to speed up CI by reducing sleeps globally.

alex: test still uses sleep(0.5) in the harness. but the branch added a small background refresh thread that may race.

ryan: could be ordering/regression from the refresh thread. two paths: (1) I can bisect the branch locally by checking out commits and running that test, or (2) we can rebase branch onto main in case it's a merge conflict that left an older cache implementation. Alex — is the branch up-to-date?

alex: branch is ~20 commits ahead of main, last rebase was 10 days ago. there were a couple of infra fixes merged afterward.

maya: simplest: try `git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main` on the feature branch and push; CI will rerun. If that fixes, it's likely a conflict/resolution issue.

taylor: I can help with a local bisect if needed. if you give me the short SHA range I can run binary search.

alex: rerun finished and failed again. same test. job log shows a flaky-setup warning about background thread: ```
WARNING: cache: background-refresh started while test harness booting
```

ryan: that warning suggests the refresh thread starts earlier due to a reorder in init. which commit touched cache init?

alex: commit list in the branch: 
- 7a1f2c4 add background refresh thread
- b3d9f11 bump default TTL to 5s
- e8c77aa tweak harness timings

maya: likely culprit is 7a1f2c4. can someone revert that commit locally and run tests?

taylor: I'll pull the branch and run `git revert 7a1f2c4` locally and run the single test on ubuntu docker image. give me ~20 mins.

alex: thanks. if revert fixes it we can discuss making refresh start lazily or behind a flag.

ci-bot: Update: rerun failed on the same test, duration 00:03:12. No other failures.

ryan: also, consider adding a small barrier in test setup to ensure background thread hasn't started: `background_thread_started.wait(timeout=1)` — that would make the test robust. But that's a test change, not ideal.

maya: agreed. prioritize fixing the race in code if revert confirms it.

(taylor leaves for 18 minutes)

ci-bot: taylor triggered local reproduce attempt (reported) — but note: local reproduce may differ from CI kernel.

alex: update — taylor confirmed locally: reverting 7a1f2c4 makes test pass repeatedly. He also ran a quick bisect narrowing to that commit.

taylor: details: I reverted commit, ran `pytest tests/test_integration_cache.py::test_cache_invalidation -k ubuntu` inside the ubuntu container 12 times — all passed. Re-applied commit, test failed 8/8.

alex: ok let's open a small PR to revert 7a1f2c4 on the feature branch, or better, modify the refresh to start after harness init. Who wants to own the fix?

maya: I can take the fix — will change refresh to start lazily and add a unit test for init ordering. I'll send a PR against the feature branch and request review.

ryan: thanks maya. Alex — once PR is up ping here and we'll watch CI.

alex: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/branch/feature/cache-ttl/pulls/96 (WIP: lazy refresh start). cc @maya

ci-bot: Pull request created by @maya — CI will run on push.

maya: pushed change and forced a small rebase to tidy up. CI is running now.

ci-bot: CI status: running (job 4823.3).

alex: thanks everyone. marking this thread resolved pending CI green. If it goes red again we'll revert the refresh change and circle back. :thumbsup:

ryan: saved the bisect notes to the branch issue for future reference.

ci-bot: Final update: job 4823.3 passed — test_integration_cache.py::test_cache_invalidation is green.

alex: awesome — closing out.
